harnessThesis.headline: The harness is the product.
harnessThesis.statement: The differentiator in Agentic SRE is the operating harness: evidence, policy bounds, visible reasoning, outcome learning, and human control before high-risk action.

linkedInSignals.name: Enterprise Context Layer
linkedInSignals.description: Operational context is an enterprise asset: ownership, change, dependency, transaction, current state, and policy must be maintained outside any single prompt.

linkedInSignals.name: Context Acquisition Tax
linkedInSignals.description: Every engineer, workflow, and agent pays the tax repeatedly when the system cannot answer who owns it, what changed, what depends on it, and which transaction is affected.

linkedInSignals.name: Harness over model
linkedInSignals.description: The durable product is the harness that captures evidence, replay, outcomes, approvals, and operational memory across incidents.

linkedInSignals.name: Dynamic operational view
linkedInSignals.description: Static topology is not enough. Agents need a current operational view that admits uncertainty, stale knowledge, contradictions, and missing evidence.

linkedInSignals.name: Ops for observability
linkedInSignals.description: Observability is becoming an operated product: source quality, retention, taxonomy, cost, governance, and feedback loops matter when humans and agents both consume telemetry.

linkedInSignals.name: Observability for AI
linkedInSignals.description: AI systems need visibility into prompts, tool calls, traces, grounding, latency, cost, refusals, overrides, and drift before enterprises can trust them.

linkedInSignals.name: Shared context problem
linkedInSignals.description: AI makes private context cheap and shared context expensive; serious operations need public, inspectable reasoning artifacts teams can converge on.

builderDna.title: The operating model
builderDna.thesis: This is not a chatbot layer for operations. It is a harness model for systems that investigate, prove, remember, replay, self-correct, and improve.

principles.name: Deterministic first
principles.description: Known operational paths should be reproducible before an LLM is allowed to add judgment.

principles.name: Proof-driven
principles.description: Every conclusion needs evidence references, missing-context statements, and confidence movement.

principles.name: Bounded autonomy
principles.description: Tool use, time, scope, and irreversible actions need explicit budgets and policy gates.

principles.name: Receipts everywhere
principles.description: Each tool call, observation, hypothesis, and decision should leave an auditable trail.

articles.title: OI-ROOM-001 Control Comparison
articles.dek: How to test the Operations Room against dashboard-only, chatbot-only, and ticket-only investigation modes.

articles.title: Operational Intelligence Is the New Control Plane
articles.dek: Why enterprises need systems that reason across signals, workflows, people, and outcomes.

articles.title: Agentic Incident Investigation Without Losing Control
articles.dek: How AI agents can accelerate enterprise investigations while keeping evidence, provenance, and accountability intact.

articles.title: Transaction Intelligence for Complex Enterprises
articles.dek: Moving from isolated telemetry to transaction-aware explanations of customer and business impact.

patterns.title: Evidence-Driven RCA
patterns.description: Root cause analysis that keeps facts, hypotheses, and uncertainty separate.

patterns.title: Transaction Journey Reconstruction
patterns.description: Rebuild the customer or business journey across systems to explain impact.

patterns.title: Agentic Incident Investigation
patterns.description: Bounded agents that decompose investigations into inspectable steps.

categoryContrast: Useful for detection; weak at preserving reasoning, uncertainty, and action provenance.
Useful for language; risky when retrieval, evidence, refusal, and approval boundaries are thin.
Useful for coordination; weak at reconstructing transaction evidence and causal movement.
Connects signal, transaction, topology, evidence, memory, evaluation, and human judgment.

primaryPaths.label: Signature artifact
primaryPaths.title: Enter the Operations Room
primaryPaths.body: Inspect OI-ROOM-001 as an evidence-backed investigation: transaction path, contradictory evidence, missing context, hypothesis movement, eval gates, and human approval.

primaryPaths.label: Doctrine
primaryPaths.title: Read the canonical model
primaryPaths.body: Start with the definition of Operational Intelligence, what it is not, the ten-layer framework, glossary, boundaries, and public-safe synthetic case.

primaryPaths.label: Public work
primaryPaths.title: Review the body of work
primaryPaths.body: See the systems, papers, patterns, reference artifacts, public work, resume proof, and professional background behind the thesis.

operatingRules: The system should separate observation, inference, contradiction, missing evidence, and confirmed fact before recommending action.
Important operational reasoning should be reproducible through approved context, replay seeds, and trust fixtures.
Consequential change stays behind owner review, approval class, reversibility, and escalation boundaries.
reviewerPaths: Can the model improve operational judgment without autonomy theater?
Are evidence, unknowns, contradictions, and approval boundaries visible?
Could two teams implement the contracts similarly?
Do retrieval, citation, refusal, and action-safety gates hold?
What has Ravikanth built, written, and made inspectable?
referenceAssets: Diagrams, tables, walkthroughs, cards, and PDFs.
Benchmark rubric, control comparisons, and falsification criteria.
falsificationTests: Evidence that weakens the preferred explanation remains in the packet.
Missing evidence is preserved instead of converted into confident narrative.
The investigation leaves enough context to reproduce how confidence moved.
Operational change remains behind owner review, reversibility, and approval class.
heroBuilderProof: 15+ years across distributed platforms, reliability, and operational workflows
agent architecture, evaluation, retrieval, and runtime governance
observability, transaction paths, incident reasoning, and human approval
operatorOriginProof: The thesis starts from running enterprise systems, not from adding AI after the fact.
The repeated failure pattern is the same: teams rediscover ownership, change, dependency, and transaction state under pressure.
The site turns that judgment into doctrine, artifacts, evals, and inspectable synthetic investigations.
